landing.heroPrimary: Connecting rural communities with continuous, accessible healthcare.
landing.heroSubtitle: Bridging physical distances, connectivity dead-zones, and doctor shortages by linking rural patients, frontline ASHA workers, doctors, and Primary Health Centres on a resilient, offline-ready platform.
landing.problemSubtitle: Over 65% of India's population lives in rural areas, facing systemic challenges that lead to preventable delays:
landing.problemCard1Desc: Healthcare apps that require live internet fail in remote hamlets, leaving field health workers stranded.
landing.problemCard2Desc: Without structured clinical triage, early symptoms of maternal complications or infections turn into emergencies.
landing.problemCard3Desc: Physical cards tear, get lost, or are forgotten at home, disrupting immunization and chronic care history.
landing.solutionSubtitle: A unified continuum of care connecting villages to Primary Health Centres:
landing.solutionCard1Desc: All vital signs, visits, and patient registrations are saved locally on device and sync automatically when signal resumes.
landing.solutionCard2Desc: Evidence-based triage rules classify patients into Red (Urgent Transfer), Yellow (Doctor Review), or Green (Routine Care).
landing.solutionCard3Desc: Permanent, patient-owned repository of prescriptions, lab tests, and vaccine certificates accessible anytime.
landing.ecosystemSubtitle: Continuous, closed-loop collaboration between patients, frontline health workers, medical officers, and district health authorities.
landing.ecosystemFlow: Patient ↔ ASHA Worker ↔ Doctor ↔ Healthcare Facility
landing.pillarPatientDesc: Empowered with maternal ANC schedules, child immunization trackers, digital health records, and one-touch emergency dispatch.
landing.pillarAshaDesc: Equipped with an offline tablet/mobile vault for household surveys, vital signs logging, symptom assessment, and doctor case referrals.
landing.pillarDoctorDesc: Reviews triage-sorted priority queues at the CHC/PHC, evaluates asynchronous clinical photos, and issues digital e-prescriptions.
landing.pillarFacilityDesc: Monitors real-time essential drug stocks, mobilizes 108 emergency ambulances, and tracks district-wide disease surveillance.
landing.aboutSubtitle: Engineered for the realities of rural public health delivery in India.
landing.aboutMission: Our mission is to eliminate healthcare disparities by building a resilient digital backbone that honors frontline community health workers and gives every rural citizen dignified, continuous medical care.
landing.aboutPillar1Desc: No spinners, no lost submissions. Every transaction is idempotent and saved immediately to local IndexedDB storage.
landing.aboutPillar2Desc: Aligned with India's RMNCH+A strategy (Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child, and Adolescent Health) and Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM).
landing.aboutPillar3Title: Low Cognitive Load for Frontline Workers
landing.aboutPillar3Desc: High-contrast large touch targets (min 48px), intuitive color signals (Red/Yellow/Green), and complete tri-lingual vernacular interfaces.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: A dependable 4-step workflow connecting rural doorstep care to medical facilities.
landing.step1Desc: ASHA workers visit rural households, capture patient vitals (Blood Pressure, SpO2, Pulse, Temp) and take photos of lesions/injuries completely offline.
landing.step2Desc: The embedded decision engine evaluates parameters instantly, highlighting high-risk maternal symptoms or oxygen drops without waiting for cloud compute.
landing.step3Desc: As soon as the device connects to mobile data or PHC Wi-Fi, records seamlessly sync to the central server with zero duplicate entries.
landing.step4Desc: Medical Officers review prioritized cases, prescribe medicines verified against PHC inventory, and dispatch 108 ambulances when needed.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Thoughtfully engineered features tailored for villagers, health workers, and administrators.
landing.featMaternalDesc: Automated trimester calendars, iron-folic acid schedules, high-risk pregnancy alerts, and emergency delivery hospital bag planner.
landing.featChildDesc: Complete national immunization timetable, polio drop schedules, growth charts, and early malnutrition risk detection.
landing.featBackpackDesc: Secure, lifelong storage for government hospital discharge summaries, blood test reports, and digital prescriptions.
landing.featStockDesc: Check real-time stock of essential drugs (Paracetamol, ORS, IFA, Amoxicillin) and diagnostic kits before traveling long distances.
landing.featEmergencyDesc: Single-tap emergency dispatch dialing 108 ambulance with automatic GPS village location sharing and simultaneous ASHA notification.
landing.featSurveillanceDesc: District Health Officers monitor fever clusters, communicable disease trends, and PHC medicine supplies across blocks.
landing.offlineSectionSubtitle: Why offline-first architecture is a life-saving medical necessity.
landing.offlineCard1Desc: Robust client-side database safely stores patient files, triage records, and clinical photographs with high integrity.
landing.offlineCard2Desc: Backend deduplication ensures intermittent network reconnects never duplicate patient files or medical histories.
landing.offlineCard3Desc: Ultra-lightweight payloads compressed to operate even on weak 2G network signals and sub-Rs. 7000 rural smartphones.
landing.offlineSimDesc: Experience how AarogyaSync switches seamlessly between offline local mode and real-time synchronization:
landing.multilingualSectionSubtitle: Native tongue interfaces eliminate literacy barriers for villagers and ASHA workers.
landing.multilingualDesc: Healthcare advice must be understood without hesitation. AarogyaSync provides 100% native language support across English, Hindi (हिंदी), and Marathi (मराठी), ensuring critical maternal warnings and dosage instructions are clearly communicated.
landing.pwaSectionSubtitle: Instant installation on any smartphone without app store downloads.
landing.pwaPoint1: Zero App Store Friction: Installs directly from any mobile browser with 'Add to Home Screen'.
landing.pwaPoint2: Ultra-Compact Footprint: Total installation size under 3 MB, sparing valuable device memory.
landing.pwaPoint3: Instant Cold Start: Service Worker shell caching ensures the app opens in milliseconds even in flight mode.
landing.ctaTitle: Experience the Future of Rural Healthcare Delivery
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join frontline health workers, medical officers, and rural communities on AarogyaSync today.
landing.footerTagline: Connecting rural communities with continuous, accessible healthcare.
landing.footerLegal: Designed in alignment with National Health Mission (NHM) and Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) standards.
landing.footerHelplines: National Rural Health Helplines: 108 (Ambulance) • 102 (Maternal & Child Transit) • 104 (Medical Advice)
